owner.help: Main aap ki dukaan ka assistant hoon. Naya product daalne ke liye us ki photo bhejein, phir voice note ya likh kar naam aur qeemat batayein. Qeemat ya dukaan ki policy badalni ho to bas bata dein, jaise: "lawn 3-piece ab 2,500 ka hai". Kharcha likhne ke liye bill ki photo "bill" likh kar bhejein, udhaar aise batayein: "Bilal ko 3000 udhaar", ya poochein "aaj ki sale?". Aaya hua maal batayein ("blue lawn ke 30 aa gaye") ya supplier ka bill "challan" likh kar bhejein, aur dekhne ke liye "products" ya "orders" bhejein.
